keywords: Revision application concerning a child custody/return dispute under the Hague Convention on International Child Abduction. The High Court had refused to return the child on procedural grounds (lack of translation) and on the basis that the child was settled in Sri Lanka. Held - translation requirement under Section 6(3) was merely directory, and that the psychiatric report did not conclusively establish settlement; Application allowed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction Act No. 10 of 2001
